attachments.insertion_landmark: lateral part of the inferior nuchal line

actions: rotates the head to the same side

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Forms the medial border of the suboccipital triangle. The suboccipital muscles have an exceptionally high muscle spindle density for their size, which is why they are treated as proprioceptive organs for head position as much as prime movers.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
